description: The Portal de Informações of CONAB, Brazil's national food supply company, gathers the agency's public dashboards and downloads on agricultural production, markets and storage. The portal read on 2026-09-28 lists 62 panels, most marked public, in areas such as supply, logistics, market, production cost and agricultural production, and a download section grouped into supply, logistics, market, production and a large mapping category of 236 files. Panels include the Portal Armazéns do Brasil, which publishes the national register of storage units (SICARM) with location, static capacity and other characteristics of the country's grain warehouses and silos; weekly and monthly price series at several levels of trade; the historical grain harvest series with planted area, production and yield by state; crop mapping vectors of cultivated areas and sugar-energy processing plants; and production cost comparisons. Coverage is Brazil, by state and in places by municipality. Access is free; the panels are marked public but no licence was read, and download formats were not checked. Caveats: many panels are interactive dashboards, and definitions differ between them. It supports food supply resilience and planning studies, such as mapping storage capacity against harvest volumes to find regions where a logistics disruption would strand grain. Related record: the WFP global food price database.
licence: not stated in the part read (panels marked public)
